title: Capture evidence writing
responsibility: Writes a requested evidence file and appends its metadata to the capture index.

inputs.name: evidenceRequested.env
inputs.description: The environment to inspect; a nonempty HARNESS_EVIDENCE_DIR and TAKE_SCREENSHOT equal to "1" are both required. Defaults to process.env.

inputs.name: recordCapture.line
inputs.description: The capture metadata serialized to the index; its file member supplies the path passed to writeFileSync beneath the evidence directory. This function does not validate the object.

inputs.name: recordCapture.bytes
inputs.description: The string or byte array written to the path selected by line.file when recording is requested. Strings are written as text and Uint8Array values as bytes.

inputs.name: recordCapture.env
inputs.description: The environment used to select the evidence directory and opt in; recording is skipped unless HARNESS_EVIDENCE_DIR is nonempty and TAKE_SCREENSHOT equals "1". Defaults to process.env.

outputs.name: evidenceRequested
outputs.description: True only when HARNESS_EVIDENCE_DIR is truthy and TAKE_SCREENSHOT equals "1".

outputs.name: recordCapture
outputs.description: Returns false without writing when evidence is not requested; otherwise it creates the directory recursively, writes the capture, appends JSON.stringify(line) and a newline to captures.ndjson, and returns true.

errors.name: Capture serialization or file write failure
errors.description: A synchronous failure from directory creation, capture writing, JSON serialization, or index appending propagates to the caller; recordCapture does not catch it.
